points.why: It says an unwanted conclusion gets fought by attacking assumptions, and that it becomes 'your claim for them to defeat' because leadership had no part in it.
It rejects more detail and proposes a live whiteboard rebuild, but it decides the contractor boundary alone as a toggle rather than agreeing it with leadership before showing results.
It recommends a sensitivity and break-even test on attrition, but it doesn't call for openly naming the value-laden choices.
It never suggests tracking which leaders helped draw the model versus only saw results, or planning those conversations.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly rejects adding detail alone and centers a participatory rebuild.
